d:
Taken from "Chapter III: We Return to Light" by Anoushka Shankar.
On March 14, the acclaimed sitar player, producer and composer, shares the third and final installment of her trilogy of mini-albums: "We Return to Light" will be released by LEITER on vinyl and via all digital platforms, and is preceded by this first single, "Hiraeth", out now.
Written by Anoushka Shankar, Alam Khan, Sarathy Korwar
Produced by Sarathy Korwar
Sitar: Anoushka Shankar
Sarod: Alam Khan
Drums, Percussion: Sarathy Korwar
Kanjira: Pirashanna Thevarajah
